title: The nanotubular network as a new dimension of intercellular communication in the nervous system
title_zh: 神经系统中细胞间通讯的新维度：纳米管网络
abstract: Communication between cells in the nervous system has long been understood to occur through chemical and electrical synapses, and through the release of signalling molecules and extracellular vesicles across the extracellular space. Intercellular nanotubes (NTs) — thin, membranous tubular bridges that physically connect distant cells — represent a structurally distinct route of communication, enabling the direct, targeted transfer of cellular cargoes between selected cells. Once studied almost exclusively in culture, NTs have now been visualized in situ and in vivo throughout the nervous system, including dendritic NTs between neurons, NTs formed by microglia and astrocytes, interpericyte NTs in the retina and NTs between satellite glia and peripheral sensory neurons. Through these connections, cells exchange mitochondria, proteins and their aggregates, and calcium, supporting three emerging roles: homeostatic rescue of stressed cells, pathological propagation of toxic proteins in neurodegeneration and non-synaptic calcium signalling, respectively. NT networks are dynamic and stress-responsive, suggesting that they provide a plastic infrastructure for resource sharing among neurons and glia. Understanding their function will require establishing a standardized definition, achieving rigorous in situ validation and quantification, and developing specific molecular tools to manipulate NTs. Intercellular nanotubes (NTs) provide a structurally distinct route of intercellular communication by enabling cellular material to be selectively transferred between cells. In this Review, Chang, Ryu and Kwon discuss the evidence for NT networks in the nervous system and the experimental approaches that can be used to study NTs in this context.
abstract_zh: 神经系统中细胞间的通讯长期以来被认为通过化学和电突触、信号分子和细胞外囊泡的释放在细胞外空间中发生。细胞间纳米管（NT）—— 物理连接远距离细胞的细膜管状桥梁——代表了一种结构独特的通讯途径，能够在选定细胞之间直接、有针对性地转移细胞货物。虽然纳米管最初几乎仅在细胞培养中被研究，但它们现在已在神经系统中体内和体内被可视化，包括神经元之间的树突纳米管、微胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞形成的纳米管、视网膜间胶质细胞纳米管以及 Satellite glia（卫星胶质细胞）与周围感觉神经元之间的纳米管。通过这些连接，细胞交换线粒体、蛋白质及其聚集体，以及钙离子，分别支持三个新兴角色：应激细胞的家态恢复、退行性疾病中有毒蛋白的病理传播以及非突触钙信号传导。纳米管网络是动态的且对应激做出反应，这表明它们为神经元和胶质细胞之间的资源共享提供了可塑的基础设施。要理解其功能，需要建立统一的定义，实现严谨的体内验证和量化，并开发特异性分子工具来操纵纳米管。细胞间纳米管（NT）通过选择性转移细胞物质，提供了一种结构独特的细胞间通讯途径。在这篇综述中，Chang、Ryu和Kwon讨论了神经系统中纳米管网络的证据以及可用于研究此类纳米管的实验方法。
